method: Each course's own York course page (default "Year of entry: 2027/28"; "Fees and funding" section and header fee line, read in a browser), plus York UK (home) tuition fees page and International tuition fees page. Course-page year selector offers only 2027/28 and 2026/27.

universityWideStatements.quote: Our 2027/28 tuition fees are £10,050 per year for UK (home) students. This includes those from the Isle of Man, Channel Islands and EU (with settled status).
universityWideStatements.title: UK (home) tuition fees - University of York
universityWideStatements.appliesTo: UK (home) fee; the page adds "Fees apply to all undergraduate courses". Stated without a caveat here, whereas course pages hedge it (see course notes).

universityWideStatements.quote: The UK government has announced its intention to increase tuition fees from £9,790 to £10,050 for the 2027/8 academic year. We expect this to apply to new UK (home) undergraduate students starting their studies in September 2027.
universityWideStatements.title: Physics (BSc) - Undergraduate, University of York
universityWideStatements.appliesTo: Hedge shown on every 2027/28 course page checked (42 show £10,050 in the fee table, 5 show TBC)

universityWideStatements.quote: Tuition fees vary by course. You can check the fees of each course on our course pages.
universityWideStatements.title: International tuition fees - University of York
universityWideStatements.appliesTo: International fees are per course, read from each course page

fees.yearEvidence: The fees and funding information here is for students starting in the 2027/28 academic year.
fees.sourceTitle: Physics (BSc) - Undergraduate, University of York
fees.note: Course page fee table shows £10,050 but caveats it: "The UK government has announced its intention to increase tuition fees from £9,790 to £10,050 for the 2027/8 academic year. We expect this to apply to new UK (home) undergraduate students starting their studies in September 2027." The UK (home) tuition fees page states without caveat: "Our 2027/28 tuition fees are £10,050 per year for UK (home) students." (https://www.york.ac.uk/study/undergraduate/fees-funding/uk/). Figures agree; caveat differs, so treated as expected. Reduced fees for a year abroad or year in industry are mentioned on the page (UK page: study abroad year 15%, placement year 20% (Turing 15%) of the full-time fee); not recorded as categories.

fees.note: Course page fee table shows £10,050 but caveats it: "The UK government has announced its intention to increase tuition fees from £9,790 to £10,050 for the 2027/8 academic year. We expect this to apply to new UK (home) undergraduate students starting their studies in September 2027." The UK (home) tuition fees page states without caveat: "Our 2027/28 tuition fees are £10,050 per year for UK (home) students." (https://www.york.ac.uk/study/undergraduate/fees-funding/uk/). Figures agree; caveat differs, so treated as expected. Reduced fees for a year abroad or year in industry are mentioned on the page (UK page: study abroad year 15%, placement year 20% (Turing 15%) of the full-time fee); not recorded as categories.
